name: How do older architectural layouts in Denver and Parker impact accessibility plans?

mainEntity.name: How do older architectural layouts in Denver and Parker impact accessibility plans?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many homes in the Denver, Centennial, and Parker areas were built with traditional split-level entries, narrow hallways, or sunken rooms that create immediate elevation changes. Modifying these spaces often requires blending ramps or slight floor leveling with existing hardwood, laminate, or tile finishes. Working across Aurora and nearby communities, HH Remodeling adapts these typical regional home layouts by reframing interior passages and smoothing floor transitions to fit each property's existing architectural structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Older area homes often have split levels and narrow halls; remodeling requires adjusting floor transitions, door framing, and trim to improve room-to-room flow.
